T: Somebody said get a life... so they did.
D: An Arkansas waitress and a housewife head off for a weekend away, and one night at a roadhouse turns them into outlaws running for Mexico.
P: Pour the margaritas when Louise says they'll be drinking them by the sea.
S: Fishing cabin cornmeal fish bites with tartare
Cornmeal fish bites with tartare, for the weekend at the fishing cabin

Stir the mayonnaise, gherkins, capers and a squeeze of lemon into a tartare. Soak the fish in the buttermilk while you mix the cornmeal, flour, Cajun seasoning and salt. Roll the fish in the cornmeal mix to coat well. Fry in batches at 180C until golden and cooked through, then drain and serve with the tartare and lemon.
500g flathead or basa fillets, in chunks@Seafood
Thunderbird onion rings with comeback sauce
Onion rings with comeback sauce, for Louise's 1966 Thunderbird convertible

Stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and hot sauce into a comeback sauce. Whisk the flour, cornflour, paprika and salt with the soda water into a light batter. Dip the rings and fry in batches at 180C until crisp and golden. Drain, salt well and serve hot with the sauce.
2 large white onions, in thick rings@Produce
M: Crumbed steak fried crisp with gravy and mash. Thelma leaves Darryl a note.

Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with a knob of butter and a splash of milk; keep warm. Season 100g flour with the garlic powder and salt, and whisk the eggs with the buttermilk. Dredge the steaks in flour, then egg, then flour again, and fry in the hot oil until crisp, 3 minutes a side. Pour off all but 2 tbsp of the fat, stir in the butter and remaining flour, then whisk in the milk and pepper and simmer into gravy. Blanch the beans and serve with the steaks, mash and gravy.
Slow-cooked pork carnitas tacos with lime. Louise is set on Mexico.

Season the pork well and put it in a heavy pot with the orange juice, garlic, cumin, oregano, bay and enough water to just cover. Simmer, covered, until the pork falls apart, then uncover and boil until the liquid is gone and the fat sizzles. Toss the onion with the juice of 2 limes and a pinch of salt and leave to pickle. Shred the pork and crisp it in its own fat in a hot pan. Warm the tortillas and fill with pork, pickled onion, salsa verde and coriander.
W: Wild Turkey pecan pie with vanilla ice cream
Thelma adds two bottles of Wild Turkey

Toast the pecans at 180C for 6 minutes, then scatter them in the pie case. Whisk the eggs, sugar, golden syrup, butter, bourbon, vanilla and a pinch of salt. Pour over the pecans and bake at 170C until just set with a slight wobble. Cool until warm and serve in wedges with the ice cream.
K: Tequila, lime and orange liqueur with a salt rim, margaritas by the sea
Run a lime wedge round 4 glasses and dip the rims in salt. Shake the tequila, triple sec, lime juice and syrup hard with ice. Strain over fresh ice and serve.
